content.title: Chapter 38 - ENVIRONMENT — Sec. 38-93. - District boundaries.
content.summary:
When a noise source can be identified and its noise is measured in more than one use
               district, the sound pressure level limits of the most restrictive use district shall
               apply at that district boundary.
(Code 1981, § 19-21; Ord. No. 2208, § 1, 9-16-1985)
